class.name: CameraSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [CameraSettingsServer]: field of view, clip planes and motion values.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"camera"[/code]. [CameraSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]) and stores it in [code]user://settings/camera.ini[/code]. Change the values through the methods of [CameraSettingsServer] or [method SettingsServer.set_value], not on the resource, so that they are validated and applied. [member enabled], [member field_of_view], [member keep_aspect], [member near] and [member far] go to the [Camera3D] nodes that [CameraSettingsServer] manages. [member shake_intensity], [member head_bob_intensity] and [member motion_blur_intensity] are game-side values ([constant SettingsServer.SETTING_FLAG_NO_ENGINE_TARGET]): the engine has no camera shake, head bob or motion blur, so the game reads them. The setters store values as they are; [CameraSettingsServer] clamps values out of range with a warning when they are set or loaded. It can also be used as the project defaults of the domain: save a [CameraSettings] as a [code].tres[/code] file and name it in the project setting [code]settings/defaults/camera[/code]. [b]Note:[/b] This class does not exist when the engine is built with [code]disable_3d=yes[/code].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the managed cameras use [member field_of_view], [member keep_aspect], [member near] and [member far]. If [code]false[/code], they get their authored values back (the values they had before they got the settings); the stored values are kept. Takes effect at once.

The distance of the far clip plane in meters, pushed to [member Camera3D.far]. A camera always gets at least [member near] + [code]0.01[/code]. Valid range: [code]0.01[/code] to [code]1000000[/code]. Takes effect at once.
The field of view in degrees, pushed to [member Camera3D.fov]. Vertical or horizontal depending on [member keep_aspect]. Valid range: [code]1[/code] to [code]179[/code]. Takes effect at once.
Game-side value: how strongly the camera bobs while the player walks, [code]0[/code] (off) to [code]1[/code] (full). The game multiplies its head bob with it. Never pushed to the engine.

Which axis [member field_of_view] is measured on, pushed to [member Camera3D.keep_aspect]. [constant Camera3D.KEEP_HEIGHT] (default): vertical FOV, the view gets wider on wide screens. [constant Camera3D.KEEP_WIDTH]: horizontal FOV, as many PC games show it. Takes effect at once.
Game-side value: the strength of the game's motion blur effect, [code]0[/code] (off) to [code]1[/code] (full). Never pushed to the engine.
The distance of the near clip plane in meters, pushed to [member Camera3D.near]. Valid range: [code]0.001[/code] to [code]10[/code]. Takes effect at once.
Game-side value: how strongly the camera shakes (hits, explosions), [code]0[/code] (off) to [code]1[/code] (full). The game multiplies its shake with it. Never pushed to the engine.
